title: Notification regarding establishment of Special Court Manipur for NIA cases at Thoubal Court complex, The High Court of Manipur, in exercise of the powers conferred direct the transfer of all NIA cases .
text:
KEY LINES:
Special Court Manipur for NIA cases vide order No. 4/40/2021-Judl/L/e-file No. Judl
303/7/2022-SEC-LAW-Part(1) dated 3rd December, 2025 of the Law and Legislative

FULL TEXT:
No. HCM/N-2013/(Judl)/ Consequent to the establishment of the
Special Court Manipur for NIA cases vide order No. 4/40/2021-Judl/L/e-file No. Judl
303/7/2022-SEC-LAW-Part(1) dated 3rd December, 2025 of the Law and Legislative
Affairs Department, Government of Manipur and further, in view of the designation of
the newly established 'Special Court Manipur for NIA cases' at Thoubal District Court
Complex, Khangabok, Manipur as the Special Court for the purpose of sub
section (1)of section11 of the NationalInvestigation Agency, Act 2008 (34
of 2008) vide Gazette Notification No. S.0. 2873(E) dated 05th June, 2026 of the
Ministry of Home Affairs, the High Court of Manipur, in exercise of the powers conferred
under Section 447 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (46 of 2023) direct
the transfer of all NIA cases from the NIA Special Court - I, Manipur at Cheirap
Court Complex to the newly established Special Court Manipur for NIA cases,
with immediate effect.
